events.name: New York Yankees at Baltimore Orioles

headlines.description: — Trent Grisham hit his 17th home run in the third inning and had a two-run single in the seventh to propel the New York Yankees to a 3-1 victory over the Baltimore Orioles on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Grisham homers and drives in all 3 runs to lift the Yankees to a 3-1 win over the Orioles

headlines.description: — Braxton Ashcraft allowed five hits over eight efficient innings, Oneil Cruz homered in his return from the injured list, and the Pittsburgh Pirates beat the Detroit Tigers 4-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Braxton Ashcraft works 8 efficient innings, Oneil Cruz homers as Pirates top Tigers 4-1

headlines.description: — Bryson Stott put the Phillies ahead with a two-run single in the sixth inning, and Philadelphia rallied for its fifth straight victory, 6-4 over the Miami Marlins on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bryson Stott's go-ahead 2-run single helps Phillies rally for 5th straight win, 6-4 over Marlins

events.name: San Francisco Giants at Cleveland Guardians

headlines.description: — Jo Adell set a career high with six RBI and hit a 455-foot, three-run homer in the first inning as the Cleveland Guardians defeated the San Francisco Giants 8-1 Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jo Adell erupts for a career-high 6 RBIs, 455-foot homer as the Guardians crush the Giants 8-1

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Cincinnati Reds

headlines.description: — Masyn Winn hit a home run and doubled twice and Kyle Leahy gave up three hits and struck out six in five innings as the St. Louis Cardinals beat the Cincinnati Reds 3-0 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Masyn Winn homers as the Cardinals shut out the Reds 3-0

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Kazuma Okamoto broke Toronto's rookie home run record with his 25th, Josh Smith and Alejandro Kirk also homered and the Blue Jays beat the AL-leading Tampa Bay Rays 10-5 on Tuesday night in the opener of their series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Okamoto sets Blue Jays rookie record with 25th home run as Toronto cruises by Rays 10-5

events.name: Arizona Diamondbacks at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Adley Rutschman hit his first homer as a member of the Red Sox, Ranger Suarez picked up his first win since late June and Boston beat the Arizona Diamondbacks 9-4 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rutschman hits 1st homer for Red Sox as Boston beats the Diamondbacks 9-4

events.name: San Diego Padres at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Fernando Tatis Jr. robbed New York's Francisco Lindor of a grand slam and hit two homers, leading the San Diego Padres to a 5-2 win over the Mets on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Fernando Tatis Jr. robs a grand slam and hits 2 homers in Padres' 5-2 win over Mets

events.name: Athletics Athletics at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Bobby Witt Jr. drove in the winning run with a two-out single in the ninth after pinch-hitter Tyler Tolbert hit a tying two-run single, giving the Kansas City Royals a 4-3 victory over the Athletics on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Witt caps Royals' rally in the ninth with the winning hit in a 4-3 victory over the Athletics

headlines.description: — The Milwaukee Brewers matched baseball's modern-era record for the biggest shutout, beating the Seattle Mariners 22-0 on Tuesday night behind three-run homers from Christian Yelich, David Hamilton and Luis Lara and a two-run shot by Jake Bauers.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brewers match baseball's modern-era record for biggest shutout, beating Mariners 22-0

headlines.description: — Josh Bell hit a two-run homer, Ryan Jeffers drove in Minnesota’s other two runs, and the Twins beat the Atlanta Braves 4-1 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bell's home run, Jeffers' two-run double push Twins past Braves 4-1

events.name: Chicago White Sox at Chicago Cubs

headlines.description: — Pete Crow-Armstrong made MLB history with a leadoff home run and Alex Bregman's RBI single gave the Chicago Cubs a second straight walk-off win over the Chicago White Sox, 4-3 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Crow-Armstrong makes MLB history, Bregman give Cubs another walk-off win over White Sox, 4-3

headlines.description: — Cal Quantrill gave up four hits in seven innings, Justin Foscue hit a home run and the Texas Rangers beat the Washington Nationals 5-0 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rangers beat the Nationals 5-0 behind Cal Quantrill’s 7 innings, Justin Foscue's homer

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Houston Astros

headlines.description: — Rookie George Klassen allowed one hit in a career-high seven scoreless innings and Josh Lowe homered to lead the Los Angeles Angels to a 3-1 win over the Houston Astros on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookie George Klassen dazzles with 7 scoreless innings as Angels beat AL West-leading Astros 3-1

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at Colorado Rockies

headlines.description: — Shohei Ohtani hit a two-run shot to reach 30 homers for the sixth straight season and Freddie Freeman had two hits and two RBI as the Los Angeles Dodgers beat the Colorado Rockies...
headlines.shortLinkText: Ohtani reaches 30 HRs for 6th straight season as Dodgers beat Rockies 7-6
